source_protocol.meta: held-out TRAIN paid transitions and separate same-domain probes; magnitude-preserving signed gain objective; one virtual SGD critic step; first-order local optimizer approximation to actual Adam; meta every 15 TD steps
source_protocol.replay: raw paper/gain components; rewards recomputed with current detached beta; no stale scalar rewards
source_protocol.preserved: source CNN, initial Context, competitive Context update, two-action DDQN gamma .95; fixed Context path
source_protocol.theory: local competitive Context update and closed-loop DDQN preserved; no exact shared min-max equivalence claim
source_protocol.validation: epoch selection by mean online AC minus positive source forgetting; fewer labels break ties
source_protocol.scope: experimental learned weight, warm-start selected DDQN; comparison not an independent no-RL retraining
source_protocol.labels: 20 percent per inner/meta trajectory; probes and prior training additional TRAIN supervision; TEST cap per level

protocol.threshold_source: saved source Actor TRAIN q75; no VAL/TEST threshold calibration
protocol.behavior: budget AND q75 mask before greedy or epsilon action selection
protocol.bootstrap: same mask applied to successor legality before online argmax and target gather
protocol.reward: unchanged paper reward plus frozen learned beta times independent same-domain TRAIN gain; skip zero
protocol.replay: fresh Q replay/Adam at continuation start; current legal transitions only; original TRAIN anchors/probes reused
protocol.initialization: source learned Q transferred; target network synchronized; CNN and initial Context unchanged
protocol.validation: epoch0 inference-only hybrid eligible; max mean online AC minus positive source forgetting, fewer labels tie-break
